subject.title: Make Codex supervision interactive and owned by the Codex plugin

question: Should the official `codex` plugin replace `codex-supervisor` as the canonical owner of federated and interactive Codex session supervision?
rationale: Current OpenClaw and upstream Codex source support consolidation, but only maintainers can authorize the shipped plugin identity, compatibility window, remote authorization boundary, and phased product scope.

options.title: Phase official consolidation
options.body: Move federation into `codex`, migrate supervisor configuration, and add operations incrementally with active-owner and upgrade proof.

options.title: Bridge both plugins
options.body: Keep `codex-supervisor` and expose a supported public capability bridge to the official Codex runtime.

options.title: Retain read-only split
options.body: Keep fleet discovery metadata-only and use existing Codex commands and tools for interaction.

recommendation.title: Phase official consolidation
recommendation.body: Move federation into `codex`, migrate supervisor configuration, and add operations incrementally with active-owner and upgrade proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The issue is assigned to `steipete` and directly continues the fleet-catalog direction merged by Peter Steinberger.
